name: Vice Chancellor - Prof. Peter N. Muchiri
description: Prof. Peter N. Muchiri is the Vice Chancellor of Dedan Kimathi University of Technology (DeKUT). He oversees university policy, strategic leadership, academic governance, and institutional growth.

name: DVC Academic Affairs & Research - Prof. Esther N. Magiri
description: Prof. Esther N. Magiri serves as the Deputy Vice Chancellor (Academic Affairs & Research). She oversees all academic programs, curricula, examinations, admissions, and research projects across all schools.
location: Main Administration Block, DVC AA Wing

name: Dedan Kimathi University of Technology (DeKUT)
description: Dedan Kimathi University of Technology (DeKUT) is a premier public university in Kenya, situated in Nyeri along the Nyeri-Nyahururu Highway. Renowned for technology, engineering, computing, innovation, science, and entrepreneurial research.

name: Registrar Academic Affairs & Examinations
description: The Office of the Registrar (Academic Affairs & Research) manages student admissions, course registration, exam timetables, transcripts, student records, and graduation clearance.

name: Dean of Students & Student Welfare Office
description: The Dean of Students office coordinates student welfare, counseling, clubs & societies, sports, financial aid/bursaries, student leadership (DeKUTSO), and campus life.

name: Lecture Attendance Policy (75% Rule)
description: All DeKUT students must attend a minimum of 75% of scheduled lectures and practical sessions in every unit to be eligible to sit for end-of-semester main examinations. Attendance is audited prior to exam card issuance.

name: DeKUT University Grading System
description: DeKUT operating grading scale: 70% – 100% = Grade A (First Class honors standard); 60% – 69% = Grade B; 50% – 59% = Grade C; 40% – 49% = Grade D (Pass); Below 40% = Grade E (Fail / Mandatory Retake). CATs contribute 30% and Main Exam 70%.

name: Examination Integrity & Disciplinary Code
description: DeKUT maintains zero tolerance for academic dishonesty. Bringing mobile phones, smartwatches, unauthorized notes into exam halls, or engaging in plagiarism results in immediate disciplinary hearing, zero grade, and potential suspension/expulsion.

name: DeKUT Main Library & Resource Center
description: Modern multi-storey resource center with physical books, computer labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, e-journals, quiet study zones, and repository access. Open Mon–Fri: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM; Sat: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

name: DeKUT Student Portal & E-Learning (LMS)
description: Students register units, check fee balances, view exam results, and download course notes via portal.dkut.ac.ke and dedicated Moodle E-Learning platform.

name: DeKUT Annual Innovation & STEM Week
description: A premier flagship event where students, innovators, and industry partners showcase software applications, robotics, AI systems, and engineering solutions to judges and investors.

name: DeKUT Past Papers Repository & Exam Revision Advice
description: Past semester examination papers are archived on repository.dkut.ac.ke and departmental Google Drives. Effective revision strategy: solve last 3 years of papers, focus on core CAT topics (30%), and practice time-budgeting (3 hours per 70-mark paper).
